topics.topic: Whether pre-send owner refusal/failure consumes an attempt_number (or only real sends/executions do)
questions: Does `refused_by_owner` consume an attempt number even though no execution/send attempt happened?
When the owner refuses an approval before any send, does that refusal consume an `attempt_number` or not?

Should `refused_by_owner` consume an attempt number even though no execution/send occurred?

topics.topic: Exact multipart value-part JSON byte encoding/stability requirements
